label: letter a read in the original phase
explanation: Fires when the input is the letter a during the original (pre-<DEL>) phase; 68% of activation mass is on these steps. Strongest on runs of repeated a (a after a, e.g. "u u a a a" reaches max on the third a; prev_tok==a & in_tok==a is 99% precise but only 15% of mass). An a at t=0 fires almost always but weakly. Precision is only ~0.39: many a inputs at t>0 do not fire, depending on preceding context (fires more after a, o, r, c, f, z, y; less after g, k, s, h, i), which no simple predicate captured. Secondary weak firing at the <DEL> step (~20% of mass, ~3% of delimiter steps) and rare weak firing on r/o/c inputs. Essentially silent in the copy phase, including when a is re-input there.
